summary: Verified implementation of linked_recurring_service_id feature for Setup→Recurrente mapping. Backend: Service model has new linked_recurring_service_id field, GET /api/services?application_type=recurring_available filter works correctly. Frontend MediosPago: Shows 'Concepto Recurrente Asociado' selector for setup/both types, fetches recurring services from API. Frontend Quotes: addMedioPagoItem detects linked service and auto-adds to recurring_basic_items, consolidateRecurringItems groups duplicates accumulating cantidad_bancos. All 85 backend tests pass (100%).
